newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3942/3.3965 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3942/3.3965 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3930 to 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3950 to 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3942 pounds bid and 3.3965 pounds offered. The averages compared to 3.3944 pounds bid and 3.3961 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.391761 buy and 3.398062 sell.
